sam (customer): Hi — after our IdP pushed a metadata update this morning, a subset of users get a SSO failure. They hit a 403 on the ACS redirect and our logs show 'No matching KeyDescriptor' in the SAML validation step. Login works if users hit the old metadata snapshot.

maria (support): Thanks @sam. Can you paste the IdP metadata URL and a redacted SAMLResponse (base64) from a failed attempt? Also, any relaystate you can share.

sam (customer): URL: https://idp.examplecorp.com/metadata.xml (they said they rotated keys around 06:12 UTC). Here's a short redacted SAMLResponse payload snippet we captured: `PHNhbWxwOlJlc3BvbnNlIHhtbG5zOnNhbWw9Imh0dHA...` — fails during signature/key lookup.

maria (support): Got it. Pulling metadata quickly. I ran `curl -sS https://idp.examplecorp.com/metadata.xml | head -n40` and noticed something odd: there are invisible characters around the EntityID and inside KeyDescriptor elements.

kevin (eng-apps): Interesting — what kind of characters? Non-breaking spaces like ` `?

maria (support): Not HTML entities. Looks like a zero-width space (U+200B) sneaked into the XML around the `entityID` attribute and between `KeyInfo` tags. Example excerpt (non-printable highlighted with ->ZWSP<-):

```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.examplecorp.com/\u200B" validUntil="2029-01-01T00:00:00Z">
  <IDPSSODescriptor>
    <KeyDescriptor use="signing">
      <!-- keydata -->\u200B
    </KeyDescriptor>
  </IDPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

kevin (eng-apps): Ah, ZWSP can break our XML canonicalization step. Our SAML parser canonicalizes (c14n) then matches the Signature/KeyInfo; stray zero-width chars inside attribute values or between tags change the digest and can cause 'no matching KeyDescriptor'.

jess (sre): Do we have heuristics to normalize metadata already? We normalize whitespace but usually only regular spaces and linebreaks.

maria (support): I tried a quick local repro: `curl -sS https://idp.examplecorp.com/metadata.xml | python -c "import sys,unicodedata; print([hex(ord(c)) for c in sys.stdin.read()[:200]])"` — shows 0x200b bytes inside the first 200 chars.

kevin (eng-apps): Workarounds: 1) Ask the IdP to remove the ZWSP and re-publish clean metadata. 2) Short-term, our metadata fetcher can run a sanitizer pass to strip ZWSP and other invisible codepoints before parsing. 3) As a defensive approach, run `lxml` with normalization + explicit c14n2 before signature verification.

maria (support): I created a ticket in our system: INC-5821 and added the metadata dump. @metadata-bot created an attachment with the raw file.

metadata-bot: Attachment added to INC-5821: idp.examplecorp.com-metadata-raw.xml

kevin (eng-apps): I'll open a small PR to add a sanitizer step that strips Unicode category Cf (format) characters and BOM-like codepoints before XML parsing. This is low-risk and keeps logs of cleaned diffs. PR will include unit tests and a toggle behind a feature flag.

jess (sre): Can we also notify the customer about an interim fix they can do on their side?

maria (support): Yes — asked them to re-export their metadata without any editors that might insert invisible chars. They said they used a GUI management console that applied a copy/paste — likely culprit. They can re-download the metadata and re-upload.

sam (customer): We can confirm our team will regenerate the metadata and republish. ETA ~45m. If it helps, we'll also provide a diff before/after.

kevin (eng-apps): Plan: (A) Roll out sanitizer behind flag in canary (eng-apps) within 2h. (B) Once customer re-publishes, test and patch if needed. (C) If sanitizer shows positive, enable globally. I'll ping here with PR link.

maria (support): Sounds good. @sam, we'll watch for your republish and run an end-to-end test. Please give us the exact timestamp of the republish to correlate.

sam (customer): Republished at 07:00 UTC. I posted the new metadata URL (same URL, cache bust param): https://idp.examplecorp.com/metadata.xml?v=0700

maria (support): Verified now — cleaned metadata no longer contains 0x200b. I triggered a login test for a previously-failing user and it succeeded. Closing this thread once PR is merged and canary validated. :white_check_mark:

kevin (eng-apps): PR: https://git.company/repo/pulls/3124 — adds sanitizer and unit tests. Rolling to canary now.

maria (support): Escalation summary for the ticket (INC-5821): root cause — zero-width space characters in IdP metadata caused canonicalization/signature mismatches and 'No matching KeyDescriptor' errors. Customer action — re-export metadata (done). Platform action — sanitizer PR + canary rollout.

jess (sre): Nice triage. Recommend we also add a small note to the SSO troubleshooting doc about invisible unicode in metadata (common when copying from rich text editors).

sam (customer): Thanks everyone, appreciate the quick help!
